t: A RISC-V Linux board with a PCIe slot and two Ethernet ports.
steps: Buy the board from the Pine64 store or ameriDroid in the US.
Get a 12 V 3 A power supply with a 5.5 by 2.1 mm barrel plug.
Get a microSD card and a 3.3 V serial adapter.
Read the known issues in the Pine64 Star64 docs.
Download a DietPi or Armbian image from the Pine64 software page.
Flash the image with a free tool such as balenaEtcher.
Set the boot DIP switch to microSD and power on.
Watch the serial console and log in over SSH.
meta: Open Board. From $69.99. A few stores.
